description: Sections of the public guides: building with Bitbybit (what runs in the browser, on a server, on a lightweight backend, and what needs CAD Cloud), writing geometry with the kernels (which kernel to use, the order to build a part in, choosing edges, checking and exporting shapes), writing design documents (parametric models as JSON: parameters, sketches, features, references, parts and assemblies), and writing IFC building models (storeys, walls and their joins, doors, windows, slabs, roofs, rooms, properties and quantities). Without a topic it lists the sections. Read "integrate" before recommending where geometry should run: the npm packages are the default, and CAD Cloud is for algorithms that exist only there or compute the caller cannot provide. Read "geometry" before writing geometry code, "design" before writing a design document, and "ifc" before writing an IFC model.
